message.reasoning:
The user wants to list all current files in temp directory, including hidden files, without changing directory structure or generating any extra directories or files. They want to do it directly in terminal. We have a tool ls that lists contents of current directory. We need to ensure we are in temp directory. We can use cd to change to temp, then ls -a. But they said "保持當前目錄結構不變" meaning keep current directory structure unchanged. Changing to temp might change current working directory. But maybe they want to list from temp without altering the current directory? We could use ls with path? The ls tool only lists current directory; but we can use find or cat? There's no direct listing of a directory other than current. But we can cd to temp, list, then cd back. That changes current directory temporarily but ends up back. That might be acceptable. Or we can use find with path param to list. find has path optional. So we can call find with path="temp" and name=None. That will list all files and directories recursively. But they want all current files including hidden. find will include hidden? It will list all items. That might be fine. But they want to avoid generating any extra directories or files. find won't generate. So we can just call find. But find returns all items recursively. They might want just top-level? They didn't specify recursion. They said "列出所有當前文件，包括所有隱藏文件". That likely means list all files in current directory, not recursively. So we need to list top-level. We can use ls -a. But we need to be in temp. We can cd to temp, ls -a, then cd back. That changes current directory temporarily but ends up back. That might be okay. But they said "保持當前目錄結構不變" meaning keep current directory structure unchanged. Changing directory doesn't alter structure. So it's fine.

Thus we should cd to temp, ls -a, then cd back. Use ls with a=True. Let's do that.
